rationale.conceptual: Implementing the Turnbull-Fisher equation with provided constants and derived expressions is a straightforward textbook exercise; no custom method or deep domain understanding needed.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of a single Python script with no data loading, external API calls, or multi-stage orchestration; just compute and write CSV.
